title.narrative: Strategic peace activities to prepare the post-agreement
Strategic peace activities to prepare the post-agreement

description.narrative: Projektet syftar till att bidra till en stabil och varaktig fred med ett brett deltagande av samhällets aktörer. Detta planeras ske genom att skapa forum för information om fredsavtalsprocessen samt underlätta debatten i genomförandet.
The Colombian government negotiating team has asked Sweden to develop strategic support activities to prepare the post agreement, within the framework of the negotiating peace talks in Havana.

sector.narrative: Civilian peace-building, conflict prevention and resolution

description.narrative: General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2016Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The expected results established in the agreement were reached. Two amendments were made to the agreement to extend the activity period of the Project and the agreement period, since additional time was required to finalize the reports requested by the Office of the High Commissioner. The peace process agenda in Havana also demanded greater work for the staff at the Office of the High Commissioner for Peace to implement their activities. All the expected Products and technical inputs were fulfilled and received by the Office. The documents were an important input to the Peace process in Havana contibuting to clarify issues within the Peace agenda. Even though changes were made in the initially planned regional forums - for one national seminar - it is the Embassy's assessment that this national seminar had a high level of debate, analysis and dialogue which contributed to reach the expected results of the Project.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
